scope: Public Workers Paid / SQLite Durable Objects reference rates, checked against Cloudflare documentation. Recheck for the actual deployment date, plan, contract, and account allocation. These are not measured usage or a complete provider price list.
notes: The subscription meter consumes the explicitly allocated subscription amount, not an additional automatic per-case fee.

Durable Object requests require the provider billing definition, including its incoming WebSocket message adjustment. Raw protocol frames and local signed HTTP requests are not interchangeable with this meter.
Native logical put calls are not Cloudflare billed SQL rows; native file byte snapshots are not GB-month measurements.
Provider relay/tunnel, D1, blob/R2, agent hosting/disk/backup, observability and taxes require their own dated rates and measured usage. Missing rates remain unknown.
Included allocations are monthly account allocations. The calculator requires prior account usage and does not grant a new allocation to each workload phase.
